download.title: Download
download.headline: homeshared
download.subtitle: Shared shopping, fridge and recipes for your household.
download.webHint: Access the app from your computer or tablet without installing.
download.pwaHint: On desktop: add a shortcut from your browser menu.
download.androidHint: Download and install the native app (sideload without Play Store).
download.androidStep1: Tap « Download APK » — the homeshared.apk file will download.
download.androidStep2: Open the downloaded file. If prompted, allow « Unknown sources » for your browser.
download.androidStep3: Confirm installation, then open homeshared from your home screen.
download.playStoreSoon: Coming soon on Play Store — use the APK above in the meantime.
download.iosHint: Apple does not allow APK installs. Use the installable web app (PWA) — same experience.
download.iosNoApk: No file to download on iOS: add the app to your home screen from Safari.
download.iosStep1: Open this site in Safari (not Chrome) and sign in or create an account.
download.iosStep2: Tap Share (square icon with arrow pointing up).
download.iosStep3: Choose « Add to Home Screen », then « Add ». homeshared opens full screen.
